summary: Tests-only red-phase run for issue #39. Committed: (1) the color_matching solver parity corpus v1 as a byte-identical test fixture plus SolverParityCorpusTests replaying all 12 scenarios against WeightedSquaredErrorScorer and the solver fast path (exact scores, exclusions, earliest-wins ties, unmatched cells); (2) PaletteAPIClientMigrationContractTests pinning /api/v1 runtime behavior and offline disk-cache round-trip so the generated-client migration cannot change it; (3) OpenAPIGeneratedClientTests (red — deliverable absent); (4) docs/solver-parity-corpus.md. Swift toolchain is NOT installed in this container, so swift test could not be executed; parity was cross-validated by an exact reimplementation of the Swift scorer over the committed corpus (0 mismatches across all 12 scenarios and every candidate), and ./bin/lint passed (it skips the Swift build by design when no toolchain exists, exit 0).
